review: Agent sampled before/event/after frame review. No exhaustive video review or user model approval. Rise/release samples show beams, flashes, washes and screen changes; some quick events are subtle between sampled frames. They remain inferred appearance changes, not isolated authored fixture cues.
v1_rejected: Clipping produced false holds; positive forecast windows were preferentially retained near gaps. Preserved unchanged and excluded from training.
v2_changes: Both forecast classes require fully observed future windows. Hold labels additionally mask clipping/high mapped energy. Audit decodes the exact fps-filter sequence used by extraction.
hold_decision: Insufficient training/validation support after saturation masks; do not fit hold head in this run. Intentional holds remain part of the project objective.
timing: 10 Hz observations and 0.3-second difference detector. Original audience audio offset and physical timing unverified.
